title: Weekly Meal Planning Kit
script_text: Start with meals you already know. Check the ingredients you have. Choose meals for the week, write one shopping list, and leave a flexible evening. The worksheet helps you make those decisions before you shop.

scenes.title: Check what you have
scenes.body: Look in the fridge and pantry before adding items to your list.

scenes.title: Choose familiar meals
scenes.body: Use your household rotation and leave one flexible evening.

scenes.title: Write one shopping list
scenes.body: List the missing ingredients and check quantities before shopping.
